description: Every Conduyt endpoint as a command, plus send-safety, import forensics, report deltas and dialer coverage no other Conduyt surface has.

novel_features.name: Send-safety check
novel_features.description: A go/no-go verdict for a send list before any SMS or drip: missing phones, unverified line types, invalid numbers and DNC hits in one table.

novel_features.name: Import delivery blame
novel_features.description: For one import job: who got the SMS, who was skipped and why, grouped by reason, including queued and exhausted side effects.

novel_features.name: Import watcher
novel_features.description: Blocks until an import job reaches a terminal state, then prints the created/updated/skipped/error recap with typed exit codes.

novel_features.name: Verification cost estimate
novel_features.description: Counts the unverified numbers in scope from the local store and shows the tenant-paid Twilio exposure before the paid verification loop runs.

novel_features.name: Targets scorecard
novel_features.description: Target versus actual per user and metric with attainment percent and pace to the end of the period.

novel_features.name: Period-over-period compare
novel_features.description: Any core report called for a window and the equal prior window, with prior, current, delta and delta percent on every numeric value.

novel_features.name: Dial coverage
novel_features.description: Priorities in dial order with queue depth per priority and the count of available agents; empty priorities are listed under empty_priorities with a warning (exit 0).

novel_features.name: Operating-hours audit
novel_features.description: Every Send SMS, Send Email and Assign step across synced automations, listed with or without an operating-hours window.
